paper_id: Shi et al. - 2006 - DS-PPS A Practical Framework to Guarantee Differentiated QoS in Terabit Routers with Parallel Packe
title: DS-PPS: A Practical Framework to Guarantee Differentiated QoS in Terabit Routers with Parallel Packet Switch
motivation: PPS在 terabit 路由器中广泛使用，但基本PPS无法支持差异化QoS，而IPTV等延迟敏感应用正在兴起。
problem_framing: 将差异化QoS需求形式化为三类流量(GD/GB/BE)，通过自适应调整交换平面的分配来精确控制延迟界和丢弃优先级。
key_insight: 将交换平面分为静态组(SAG)和动态组(DAG)，静态组保证严格延迟界，动态组按需测量分配——利用平面数作为QoS控制的杠杆。
method_signature: HAP-LB层次分配策略 + 测量驱动的动态平面划分 + M/D/1队列建模的统计延迟界证明。
evaluation_criteria: GD类平均延迟减少率、GB类在hotspot下的吞吐量保障、统计延迟界与理论界的吻合程度。
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 静态类须满足峰值带宽有界条件；动态分配的测量周期(100ms)可能无法跟踪极速流量波动。
evidence_for_taste: both the IntServ and DiffServ are not appropriate
the IntServ is costly and impractical
DiffServ is inoperable since it offers little quantitative QoS disciplines
neither do support the differentiated QoS or are not practical
no theoretical upper bound on the buffer size is given
each plane would need to implement large numbers of costly priority queues
our DS-PPS is universal and scalable
thinking_moves: 先批判现有方案(IntServ/DiffServ)不适用于PPS场景，指出成本高或缺乏可量化保证
将QoS问题转化为交换平面分配问题，用平面数作为控制粒度
将队列论模型(M/D/1)作为延迟界存在性的形式化保证
将理论界与prototype实测对齐，验证工程可行性
